_readme: Short text for the Decision card (one advantage, one disadvantage per option). Numbers come from data/tables/parts.csv; edit only the wording here.

simple.name: Standard crop camera
simple.pro: Small files that are easy to send home.

advanced.name: High-detail crop camera
advanced.pro: Spots crop disease a normal camera misses.
advanced.con: Huge files that fill storage and the radio link.

simple.name: Body solar panels
simple.pro: Light, cheap and nothing can break.

simple.name: Small battery
simple.con: May run flat in Earth's shadow.

advanced.name: Large battery
advanced.pro: Keeps everything running in the dark.

simple.name: Basic radio (S-band)
simple.con: Slow: big data gets stuck in space.

advanced.name: Fast radio (X-band)
advanced.pro: Sends about 15 times more data home.
advanced.con: Uses more power and costs more.

advanced.name: Smart computer
advanced.pro: Sends only the useful parts of each picture.

advanced.name: Precise pointing
advanced.con: Costs more and uses more power.

simple.name: Insulating blankets
simple.con: The battery gets cold in the shadow.

advanced.name: Heaters
advanced.pro: Keeps the battery warm and healthy.
